corpus: four REAL pages captured HEADED against the live network (DEFECT-009)
rule: FROZEN. Do not add entries mid-build — a corpus that grows while you work grows toward what you already pass.
whatV1CouldNotMeasure: V1 asked ONE truncation question against a defect reproducing ~1 in 14, so it scored 100% on code that had not been shown to work. V2 asks FOUR, on four different real pages.
andTheOtherMeasuredWeakness: V1 had no page where two same-named elements are GENUINELY distinct. The name-echo prune removes manufactured duplicates; it must NOT remove real ones. Three role-ambiguity questions test exactly that.
